hero.title: Over 30 Years of Experience in Automotive Spare Parts
hero.subtitle:
D&W has been serving Myanmar's automotive spare parts industry since 1995, building expertise in

OEM spare parts

, vehicle compatibility, reliable sourcing, and customer service.

intro.title: Built on Experience. Moving Forward with Technology
intro.p1: Founded in 1995, D&W began its journey in the stationery business before expanding into the automotive spare parts industry. Through years of experience, we have built strong expertise in OEM parts, product compatibility, and reliable sourcing.
intro.p2: Today, we combine our extensive industry knowledge with modern technology to deliver a more accurate, transparent, and efficient automotive spare parts sourcing experience for our customers.

m1.title: The Beginning
m1.p1: D&W began its operations in 1995, initially as a pen-related business before transitioning into the automotive spare parts industry. The company entered the market with air filter color-changing machinery and gradually expanded its product range, with a strong focus on valve cover gaskets and brake shoes.
m1.p2: Over the years, D&W built a reliable supplier network across Taiwan, China, South Korea, and Japan.

m2.title: Expanding Automotive Expertise
m2.p1: In 2006, one of D&W's founders returned to Myanmar and became fully involved in the company's operations.
m2.p2: During this period, D&W also imported and sold selected Japanese vehicles, allowing the company to develop a deeper understanding of OEM numbers, vehicle compatibility, and spare-parts applications.

m3.title: Moving Into the Digital Era
m3.p1:
In 2026, D&W entered a new stage of growth by developing a

Digital B2B Platform

together with an integrated ERP inventory management system.
m3.p2: This transformation aims to improve inventory accuracy, streamline order processing, strengthen customer service, and provide more efficient and reliable delivery timelines for customers across Myanmar.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our auto parts and services.

items.question: How do I know if a part is compatible with my vehicle?
items.answer: Check the OEM part number and your vehicle's make, model, and year. If you are unsure, contact our team for assistance.

items.question: What is your return and warranty policy?
items.answer: Return and warranty conditions may vary by product. Please contact our team with your order details to confirm the applicable policy.

items.question: How long does delivery take within Myanmar?
items.answer: Delivery within Yangon typically takes 1–2 days. For other cities, delivery to highway bus terminals typically takes 1–2 days, depending on the arrangement.

items.question: Do you offer bulk pricing for auto repair shops?
items.answer: Please contact our team with your required products and quantities to discuss bulk orders and applicable pricing.

items.question: Are your auto parts genuine OEM or aftermarket?
items.answer: Our catalog may include different types of auto parts. Please check each product's details or contact our team to confirm its origin and specifications.
